heroText: Abisko works best as a base in Sweden when you anchor days around Abisko National Park, Aurora Sky Station and Kungsleden trail. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Kiruna Airport (KRN) handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.
